description.value:
You attempt to encase one creature you can see within range in carbonite. It must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or become restrained as its flesh begins to harden.

A restrained target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns; three successes end the power, while three failures turn it to stone, subjecting it to the petrified condition for the duration (successes and failures need not be consecutive). Physical damage suffered while frozen carries over if the creature later reverts to its original state.

If you maintain concentration for the power's full possible duration, the creature remains frozen in carbonite until the effect is removed by other means.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 6
